# XP.css caption controls

Source: https://github.com/botoxparty/XP.css
Revision: 376f42eb274361939eaad3b0943204c053ad26c4
MIT license, copyright 2020 Adam Hammad and Jordan Scales.
The twelve original caption SVGs are retained here; 3x PNG rasterizations are
bundled in assets/xp-controls. Native Android rendering handles the caption
hit areas, other schemes and classic controls. The MIT notice is in the APK.
